name: My Zypps - Ounce - Hella Jelly
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Hella Jelly ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Hella Jelly brings a sweet, fruit-forward profile: juicy berry and tropical fruit notes up front with a jammy, candy-like finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Hella Jelly flavor — juicy berry and tropical fruit with a jammy finish

My Zypps Hella Jelly is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
